svg.text: pick / swap R and C anywhere
[Success | Idle | Staleness | Seam jump] ● Sync ■ Naive ◆ Inpaint
x = latency d (100 ms steps) · y = metric (shared) · │ = 95 % interval
question bar sets A and B · click mark = C · shift-click = R · hover = value & Δ vs R
right part: attribute of the question chosen in A (no own controls)
click cell = open episode (column → C) · click header = C · click band = select its seeds
R · Sync d4 h4 ✗ · idle: waiting for inference
C · Inpaint d4 h4 ✓ · acting, 4 steps stale · thinking
— executed part of chunk ┄ thrown away ⋯ next chunk computing ━ seam
hover planned point = when planned / executed · click = jump · ← → space
think = inference · act = chunk executed (hatched = idle) · lollipop = seam gap · sync alternates, async overlaps
drag = time window (→ path highlighted in C) · hover chunk = its plan in C · click = cursor
